text.name: eq_enter_injured
text.text: That horse is injured: %d month(s) until it heals.

text.name: eq_enter_sick
text.text: That horse is ill. Treat it on its Diseases page first.

text.name: eq_enter_unwell
text.text: That horse's health is too low to compete (25 or under). Feed it well and it will recover.

text.name: eq_enter_lowHealth
text.text: Its health is %d: a %d%% chance it's scratched as unsound on the day. Under 50 health, every 5 points lower adds 10%%, and at %d or under it can't compete.

text.name: eq_result_scratched
text.text: %s was scratched from %s (%s). %s of the entry fee was refunded.

text.name: eq_scratch_inFoal
text.text: too far in foal to compete

text.name: eq_scratch_fractious_2
text.text: too wound up to be tacked up

text.name: eq_scratch_fractious_3
text.text: refused to go to the start

text.name: eq_injury_newTreatable
text.text: %s was injured in %s: %s. Treat it from the horse's Diseases page (%s, %s), or leave it to heal on its own in %d month(s).

text.name: eq_injury_newRest
text.text: %s was injured in %s: %s. %d month(s) of box rest.

text.name: eq_illness_new
text.text: %s picked up %s at %s. See its Diseases page.

text.name: eq_injury_careerEnding
text.text: %s suffered a career-ending injury in %s and has retired from competition.

text.name: eq_injury_recovered
text.text: %s has recovered and can compete again.

text.name: eq_retire_doneInjured
text.text: Retired from competition. Its injury still has to heal, but treatment now costs %d%% less.

text.name: eq_retire_careerEnded
text.text: That horse's career ended with an injury; it cannot compete again.

text.name: eq_enter_settling
text.text: That horse is still settling in after the move. It can compete from next month.

text.name: eq_enter_rested
text.text: That horse has had %d starts this month and needs a rest. It can run again next month.

text.name: eq_reveal_better
text.text: You've gotten to know %s better, and they look even better than the dealer let on.

text.name: eq_reveal_worse
text.text: You've gotten to know %s better, and you have a feeling you might have been misled.

text.name: eq_reveal_fair
text.text: You've gotten to know %s better and have a firmer idea of their potential.

text.name: eq_ui_retireConfirm
text.text: Retire %s from competition? It won't be able to enter events. You can bring it back later.

text.name: eq_ui_retireConfirmInjured
text.text: Retire %s from competition? Its injury treatment will cost %d%% less, but it won't be able to enter events. You can bring it back later, at the full fee.

text.name: eq_ui_unretireConfirm
text.text: Bring %s back into competition? Any injury treatment goes back to the full fee.

text.name: eq_ui_dayTreatmentConfirm
text.text: Treat %s for %s? It takes %s and costs %s.

text.name: eq_ui_horseDescription
text.text: Horses eat hay, grain and treats and need water. Healthy mares over 22 months can breed.

text.name: eq_ui_status_eventFull
text.text: Two of your horses already entered

text.name: eq_deliver_done
text.text: %s delivered. It leaves for its event.

text.name: eq_deliver_doneMany
text.text: %d horses delivered. They leave for their events.

text.name: eq_deliver_noRoom
text.text: Can't deliver: your horses need a free place in one of your pastures to come home to.

text.name: eq_deliver_ask
text.text: %s is waiting to go to an event. Deliver now, or open the dealer as usual?

text.name: eq_deliver_askMany
text.text: %d horses in this trailer are waiting to go to their events. Deliver them now, or open the dealer as usual?

text.name: eq_loose_broughtHomeUnnamed
text.text: Your staff brought a loose horse back to %s.

text.name: eq_ui_deadline_month
text.text: before the end of the month

text.name: eq_ui_noEvents
text.text: No events are open right now. New ones are drawn each round.

text.name: eq_ui_noResults
text.text: Your horses have no results yet.

text.name: eq_ui_clientNote
text.text: Competitions are run by the host. Entering from a multiplayer client comes in a later version.

text.name: eq_ui_noConfig
text.text: The event list could not be loaded; see the log.

text.name: eq_ui_summary_event
text.text: %s: %s, rating %.0f-%.0f, field of %d. Select a horse and press Enter.

text.name: eq_enter_noEvent
text.text: That event is not open for entries.

text.name: eq_enter_retired
text.text: That horse has retired from competition.

text.name: eq_enter_inFoal
text.text: That mare is too far in foal to compete. She can compete again after foaling.

text.name: eq_enter_foaled
text.text: That mare is still recovering from foaling. She can compete three months after the birth.

text.name: eq_enter_already
text.text: That horse is already entered in %s.

text.name: eq_enter_eventFull
text.text: You can enter at most %d horses in one event.

text.name: eq_enter_tooYoung
text.text: Too young: this event is for horses of %d months and over, and yours is %d months.

text.name: eq_enter_tooOld
text.text: Too old: this event is for horses up to %d months, and yours is %d months.

text.name: eq_enter_ratingLow
text.text: Rating %.0f is below this event's %.0f-%.0f range.

text.name: eq_enter_ratingHigh
text.text: Rating %.0f is above this event's %.0f-%.0f range: enter a higher tier.

text.name: eq_enter_noMoney
text.text: Not enough money for the entry fee.

text.name: eq_enter_doneManual
text.text: %s entered in %s (rating %.0f). Manual Transport: take the horse to the animal dealer %s, or it won't start.

text.name: eq_result_notDelivered
text.text: %s was never delivered to %s, so didn't start. The entry fee is lost.

text.name: eq_enter_farmLimit
text.text: You have used all %d of this month's entries. More open next month.

text.name: eq_result_gone
text.text: %s could not run in %s: the horse is no longer on a farm.

text.name: eq_settings_trainingRate_tooltip
text.text: How fast riding, staff and events raise a horse's stats. 1x is the normal rate.

text.name: eq_settings_cadence_tooltip
text.text: How often the round of show events runs. Changes apply from the next round.

text.name: eq_settings_racing_tooltip
text.text: Whether flat races and steeplechases are on the event calendar. Changes apply from the next round.

text.name: eq_settings_injuries_tooltip
text.text: Whether horses can be injured at events.

text.name: eq_settings_forcedRetirement_tooltip
text.text: Whether the worst event injuries can end a horse's competition career for good.

text.name: eq_settings_entriesPerMonth_tooltip
text.text: How many event entries each farm can make a month.

text.name: eq_story_jumping_struggled
text.text: Really struggled with the difficulty of the course.

text.name: eq_story_jumping_elimRefusal
text.text: Went out after refusing three times.

text.name: eq_story_jumping_agility
text.text: Had a pole down at a tricky combination.

text.name: eq_story_jumping_hardest
text.text: Going well until a pole fell at the hardest fence.

text.name: eq_story_jumping_speed
text.text: Was slow between fences and lost time.

text.name: eq_story_dressage_clean
text.text: A polished test that impressed the judges.

text.name: eq_story_dressage_struggled
text.text: Struggled with the test from start to finish.

text.name: eq_story_dressage_agility
text.text: Lost marks in the lateral work.

text.name: eq_story_dressage_hardest
text.text: An elegant routine but struggled with the hardest movements.

text.name: eq_story_dressage_temperament
text.text: Grew tense in the arena and lost marks.

text.name: eq_story_dressage_temperamentMany
text.text: Tense and distracted for most of the test.

text.name: eq_story_dressage_elimRefusal
text.text: Refused to go on and retired from the test.

text.name: eq_story_crossCountry_struggled
text.text: Found the course too big and struggled throughout.

text.name: eq_story_crossCountry_agility
text.text: Ran out at a narrow fence.

text.name: eq_story_crossCountry_hardest
text.text: Going well until a run-out at the hardest fence.

text.name: eq_story_crossCountry_stamina
text.text: Tired over the last few fences.

text.name: eq_story_crossCountry_staminaMany
text.text: Ran out of energy well before the finish.

text.name: eq_story_race_clean
text.text: Ran a great race from start to finish.

text.name: eq_story_race_elimRefusal
text.text: Played up at the start and was pulled up.

text.name: eq_story_race_temperament
text.text: Missed the break at the start.

text.name: eq_story_race_speedMany
text.text: Lacked the speed to stay with the leaders.

text.name: eq_story_race_staminaMany
text.text: Ran out of steam well before the finish.

text.name: eq_story_race_finish
text.text: In contention until the leaders quickened away at the finish.

text.name: eq_story_steeplechase_struggled
text.text: Struggled with both the fences and the pace.

text.name: eq_story_steeplechase_elimRefusal
text.text: Refused a fence and was pulled up.

text.name: eq_story_steeplechase_agility
text.text: Hit a fence hard and lost ground.

text.name: eq_story_steeplechase_agilityMany
text.text: Jumped poorly and lost ground at several fences.

text.name: eq_story_steeplechase_hardest
text.text: Travelling well until a blunder at the biggest fence.

text.name: eq_story_steeplechase_stamina
text.text: Tired and faded over the last fences.

text.name: eq_story_eventing_struggled
text.text: Found all three phases a struggle.

text.name: eq_story_eventing_eliminated
text.text: Went out after a fall on the cross country.

text.name: eq_story_eventing_elimRefusal
text.text: Went out after refusals on the cross country.

text.name: eq_ui_summary_results
text.text: A horse's last %d events. Pick a horse on the right.
